thread:
Jess R: Heads-up — TideWave SI run hit a provisioning failure on their private deployment during the final adapter install. customer is blocked on go‑live tomorrow. can we triage? :alarm_clock:
Samir: on it. what's the exact error they see? any logs from the image deploy step?
Jess R: pasted below from field eng: 
```
[2026-04-05T18:12:03Z] installer: applying adapter.tidewave/v1
[2026-04-05T18:12:04Z] adapter: loading kernel modules
[2026-04-05T18:12:04Z] error: module 'nvidia_uvm' failed to load: version mismatch
```
They said nodes have older 450.x drivers, but we pushed image built against 525 runtime.
Elaine W: ok this smells like kernel/driver mismatch. are they using our marketplace image or a private signed artifact?
Jess R: private image signed by partner; we did validation check before hand. Integrator says they couldn't update drivers due to vendor firmware freeze.
Mohit K: two quick options — (1) switch to our quantized fallback adapter image that ships with the 450-compatible runtime, or (2) temporarily set the adapter to software fallthrough by disabling hw accel at boot. Option 1 is cleaner.
Samir: can we spin a one-off fallback image for them now? how long to publish?
Mohit K: I can tag an existing release with the 450 runtime and publish to the partner registry — ~20–30 mins if we have approvals. need a PR to bump the image tag and a signed attestation record.
Jess R: customer prefers minimal change — they'd rather not reboot nodes twice. if switch is just a pull+restart it's ok. can we do hot-restart without kernel changes?
Mohit K: yes for the fallback image it's just container replacement, no kernel modules required. for the kernel module path they'd need a reboot and driver update (not possible for them).
integrations-bot: created ticket #INT-4821 for "TideWave adapter fallback image publish" and assigned to Mohit K. ETA field set to 30m.
Elaine W: I'll join the call with the integrator at 18:40 PT to sign the deploy checklist and confirm rollback plan.
Samir: i'll prepare a canary rollout policy and autoscale guard so if adapter fails we route to hosted inference for 1% traffic.
Jess R: perfect. action items: Mohit publish fallback image + attestation (INT-4821), Samir prepare canary + routing policy, Elaine join integrator call. i'll notify customer and shift go‑live window if we need extra time. :white_check_mark:
Mohit K: starting the image tag now, will post the new digest here when done.
Jess R: thanks team — please update thread with any blocker.
